caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur, rendered in shades of brown, grey, and black. The spur includes a U-shaped body with a rectangular area at one end, where a slot and circular fastening mechanism are visible. Extending from the curve of the body is a central arm that leads to a large, multi-pointed, star-shaped rowel with six sharply tapered, evenly spaced points attached by a visible bolt in the center. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature, “W.J. Goodacre,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Spur
